description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Shroud], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Sinister Incursion Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Shroud
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Dark abilities

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Sinister Incursion Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Sinister Incursion 1/2 after using 1/2+2n Dark abilities

description.name: Sinister Incursion 2
description.text: Four single attacks (2.04 each), grants [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] to all allies

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
